question: What library do I use to build a passkey-based smart wallet on Stellar?

golden.answer: Two maintained SDKs fit. `stellar/passkey-kit` ships its own smart-wallet contract with a flat multi-signer `Signatures` model; `stellar/smart-account-kit` wraps the OpenZeppelin smart-account contracts with context rules and policies. They are not drop-in compatible, so choose by authorization model. As of 2026-11-14 Passkey Kit labels its contract, SDKs and relayer unaudited, Smart Account Kit labels its SDK unaudited, and the OpenZeppelin contract audit does not cover either SDK.
keyFacts: `stellar/passkey-kit` ships its own contract with flat multi-signer authorization.
`stellar/smart-account-kit` builds on OpenZeppelin smart accounts with context rules.
The two kits are not drop-in compatible; choose by authorization model.
Passkey Kit and the Smart Account Kit SDK are labeled unaudited (as of a stated date).
avoid: Do NOT call Passkey Kit legacy, superseded or demo-only; its README presents Smart Account Kit as a sibling.
Do NOT say the OpenZeppelin contract audit covers either SDK, relayer or indexer.
golden.notes: Saying Passkey Kit is unaudited is accurate and must not be penalized.
